summary: Approved as readable, behavior-validated unmatched C++; zero matching-source byte credit.
reason: Reviewed every submitted source/header, metadata, reference assembly and original caller disassembly. Control flow, 24-byte layout, unsigned capacity threshold, delete arguments and reset side effects agree within the documented scope. The default validation’s empty-only original comparisons and ABI, allocator and fault limitations are explicitly disclosed. Sampled validation does not establish all-input equivalence.
